bed_reason: Steam page has two official trailers, both opened: 'Harvest & Mine Trailer' (140 s) and 'Forgotten Powers Demo Update' (80 s). faster-whisper (VAD on and off) hears a narrator over both for almost their whole length (Harvest 6.7 s to 137 s; Forgotten Powers 0 to 76 s), so no speech-free stretch exists and a music_only stem is not allowed on a narrated trailer; the Reel runs on our bed

angle.hook: 108,000 players tried the Dawn of Defense demo and the strategy tower-defence roguelite launches on Steam on 17 Nov
angle.why_now: launch is Tuesday 17 Nov, three days after the slot; Tbreak (Gulf outlet) puts the launch at 7pm UAE time
angle.what_it_means_here: UAE players can wish-list it on Steam now; no price has appeared, and the game has no Arabic
angle.payoff: price not announced and no Arabic: both shown on the strip
